work.note: Dora the Explorer é uma série animada infantil americana, criada por Chris Gifford, Valerie Walsh Valdes e Eric Weiner e exibida pelo canal Nickelodeon desde 2000. paragraphs: It is Saturday afternoon in a busy store in Miami. Warm air comes in from the street. Max walks to the service desk with a small box. Xia works there with a kind smile. Max puts the box on the desk. Xia says hello.
“Hi, Max! Can I help you?” says Xia. “Yes, please. I bought these headphones yesterday.” says Max. “Is there a problem with them?” says Xia.
